description: This file defines an API client for user authentication operations such as signup and login, utilizing fetch calls to backend endpoints and handling error messages. It also provides a method to persist authentication tokens in local storage.

methods.name: readErrorMessage(resp)
methods.description: Attempts to extract a meaningful error message from a failed fetch response, defaulting to a generic message if parsing fails.

methods.name: signup({ name, email, phone, password })
methods.description: Sends a POST request to register a new user with the provided data, handling errors and returning the JSON response.

methods.name: login({ email, password })
methods.description: Sends a POST request to authenticate a user with email and password, handling errors and returning the JSON response.

methods.name: persistAuth(authResponse)
methods.description: Stores authentication tokens and user info in local storage for maintaining user session.

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^export async function signup({ name, email, phone, password }) {$/
